mission_05: CutMix is an augmentation technique that combines two images by cutting a rectangular patch from one image and pasting it onto another. The label is adjusted proportionally to the area of each image's contribution. Unlike mixup which blends pixel values, CutMix preserves the original pixel values, creating more realistic training samples. This encourages the model to learn from partial objects and improves localization ability. In this mission, you will implement CutMix on simulated 8x8 grayscale images, learning how to calculate bounding boxes, perform the cut-and-paste operation, and adjust labels based on area ratios.
